Payout of 10 July is short ₹2,431.44.
The bank credited ₹2,43,826.71 against an expected ₹2,46,258.15. 26 orders sit in this payout. No refund, chargeback or payment in the gateway ledger accounts for the difference, so the cause is not yet identified.
Suggested action: request the gateway's own breakdown for this payout, and check for a dispute debited but not yet reported.
